reason: Holds a write until the address is announced, which the release's hook does not. The release's hook reads the address through Next's useSearchParams; this one reads it through src/lib/address.ts and owes its readers two things for that: they are told once the navigation has committed, and a write stays shown until they are told. The transition settles one render before that, and a search box kept with the release's useSearchDraft took the address as it was before the write for a change from elsewhere: on /teams a key typed up to 40 ms after the box's own write was lost in 15 of 24 trials, and in 0 of 24 with the write held (2026-10-14). tests/query-state-search.test.tsx holds it, and with the release's file all 4 of its cases and 4 of tests/period-in-the-address.test.tsx's fail (2026-10-14), because their router answers useSearchParams with an error. The prerender cost that was this entry's first reason is gone now that every page is gated on the request: on 2026-10-14 three builds of 1d661f4 were served side by side against one fake gateway, warmed with one GET per route, and measured in two passes alternating build by build on the phone profile at 390 px, vitals.ts then scripts/primary-data.ts as the superadmin. With this file and with the release's, /teams painted at 0.62 s in every pass, /people at 0.60 to 0.62 s and /activity at 0.61 to 0.63 s; primary data took 2,395 to 2,401 ms against 2,376 to 2,421 on /teams, 2,353 to 2,354 against 2,346 to 2,347 on /people, and 2,270 to 2,273 against 2,266 to 2,272 on /activity. Before the gate the same file cost /teams 0.63 s -> 2.27 s (2026-10-12). Reported upstream as zz-meridian#22, closed; this entry comes out when the release holds a write until its readers are told.

The product's own period vocabulary, which this file's own comment says a product edits here so the picker follows: a 24-hour period, all time as the default (a console that opens on 30 days shows a total that is not the total), and `periodCutoff`. Meridian manages the file and also directs a product to edit it; reported upstream as zz-meridian#24.
